messages.subject: Please route to HR leadership | Energy, ESG and country stakeholder executive
messages.body:
Dear UAC Global Team,

I am contacting UAC through the company’s published general-inquiries channel after my earlier message to Investor Relations was rejected by my email provider before delivery. I would appreciate your routing my attached executive profile to Mr. Saner Ukort, Vice President Human Resources, or the appropriate senior talent leader.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder strategy across a major industrial operation.

UAC’s portfolio across energy, chemicals, utilities and alternative-energy investment aligns closely with my experience. I bring structured public-sector engagement, sustainability execution, cross-functional issue management and practical energy-transition exposure, including stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional leadership mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, ESG, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership or related executive roles. I am internationally mobile and available following a 30-day notice period.

My attached CV is tailored to UAC Global. I would value a confidential discussion with the relevant senior leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
